card.line: Tarshish was a far-off place across the sea, known for ships and rich cargo, and it is the place Jonah tried to run to when he fled from the LORD.

moments.title: Ships bring treasure
moments.text: King Solomon had ships of Tarshish at sea with Hiram's fleet. Once every three years they came back with gold, silver, ivory, apes, and peacocks.

moments.title: Ships wrecked
moments.text: Jehoshaphat agreed to make ships to go to Tarshish. Eliezer prophesied against him because of his alliance with Ahaziah, and the ships were wrecked and could not sail.

moments.title: Jonah runs away
moments.text: God told Jonah to go to Nineveh. Instead, Jonah went to Joppa and boarded a ship bound for Tarshish, away from the presence of the LORD.

moments.title: Wail, ships of Tarshish
moments.text: Isaiah spoke against Tyre and told the ships of Tarshish to wail, because Tyre was laid waste and its harbor was gone.

moments.title: Ships bring God's children home
moments.text: God says the islands will wait for Him, with the ships of Tarshish in the lead. They will bring His people from afar, with silver and gold, to honor the LORD.
